_about: Regression cases from the adversarial reviews of the rule-based extractor: 2026-09-21, and from 'The electrician is coming tomorrow at 10' on, 2026-09-23 (relabelled for this file's reference moment). From 'Eh, call Anna at 5.' on, the generalisation and robustness reviews of 2026-09-23, relabelled the same way; from 'After the guests leave, wash the dishes.' on, variants of those findings that still failed after the first round of fixes; from 'Buy milk, need to call Anna at 5.' on, the review of those fixes, which found rules broader than their findings and notes that failed before them too. Every case reproduced a real bug. '*' accepts any value. From "Pay the Internet bill. It's due on the 25th." on, whisper transcripts of the voice evaluation's TUNE clips (dev, fresh and complex-dev cases, as whisper base.en wrote them), each a note the extractor lost to how whisper writes speech down; the complex-dev ones relabelled from 2026-09-23T15:00 to this file's reference moment. From "Remind me in 15 minutes to call the plumber, then tonight at 9 cent the invoice to Rustam." on, whisper-style variants of the four ways the owner's on-device transcripts of 2026-09-23 failed (extraction_device_transcripts.json), labelled for this file's reference moment: a "then" and a when before a verb whisper misheard or no rule knows; a full stop whisper put between "then <when>" and the task it introduces; the comma left out before "on <date>" and a verb; and two whens in one clause, the clock time said with a day of its own.
